evidence.building_height_band: with a height greater than 2.5 metres

calculation_handling.description: An ancillary building or structure taller than 2.5 m or larger than 10 m2 GFA must be at least 1.8 m from a residential building on the same lot.
calculation_handling.gaps: The condition is a disjunction of a height test (proposed_height_m of the ancillary building) and a GFA test (gfa_m2 of the ancillary building); there is no GFA band token, so only building_height_band is listed. The heights and GFAs of proposed ancillary structures are scenario values.

calculation_handling.description: A ground-mounted heating or air-conditioning device in the rear yard may be no more than 2.0 m from the rear main wall of the residential building.
calculation_handling.gaps: separation_m is normally a minimum between buildings; here it is a maximum distance between a device and the rear main wall, the nearest vocab target. building_types any: "the residential building" names no type. Equipment placement is not part of the envelope calculation.

10.5.60.30(1).explanation: In residential zones, a shed, garage or other ancillary structure taller than 2.5 m or larger than 10 m2 must be at least 1.8 m away from the house.

10.5.60.30(2).explanation: In residential zones, a ground-mounted air conditioner or heat pump in the rear yard must be within 2.0 m of the house's rear wall.
